talk.transcript: Today, I will explain the concept of photosynthesis. Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. This process occurs mainly in the leaves, where chlorophyll captures sunlight. The glucose produced serves as energy for the plant, while oxygen is released into the atmosphere. Photosynthesis is essential for life on Earth, as it provides the oxygen we breathe and forms the base of the food chain.

questions.q: What do plants convert during photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 植物在光合作用中轉化二氧化碳和水。
光合作用主要發生在葉子中。

questions.q: What is produced as a byproduct of photosynthesis?
questions.explain: 光合作用的副產品是氧氣。

options: It is a source of energy
questions.explain: 光合作用提供氧氣和食物，對生命至關重要。
